text_block_list.name: Girl in Red Hat
text_block_list.text: No way! Absolutely not!!

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text: Wah... ugh... but, but...

Are they fighting? Just as I was about to 
call out to them with concern, two 
familiar girls approached them.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Did you two get into a fight? Are you 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Come on, don't cry. Uh, handkerchief, 
handkerchief...!

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text: I-I'm okay... I have one... *sniff*.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Could you tell big sis what happened?... 
Hmm—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I know! How about both of you eat some ice 
cream with us big sisters?

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text: ...I want strawberry.

text_block_list.name: Girl in Red Hat
text_block_list.text: I'll have chocolate chip...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Alright, leave it to big sis! I'll go 
order!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Ines? Didn't you just say things were 
'pretty tight this month!'?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
T-That's right! I haven't gotten paid from 
my part-time job yet...
choice_data_list: If you'd like, I can treat you guys.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh, really!? ...Then I think I'll take 
you up on that...!

text_block_list.name: Two Girls
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the treat!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... thanks from me too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Looks like they've both calmed down. 
...Hey, why were you two fighting?

text_block_list.name: Girl in Red Hat
text_block_list.text:
Listen to this! She said she's suddenly 
moving away!

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna move either... But I thought 
I had to say a proper goodbye...

text_block_list.name: Girl in Red Hat
text_block_list.text:
Then you won't play with me anymore! 
You'll just play with other kids far 
away...!

text_block_list.name: Girl in Red Hat
text_block_list.text: I-I don't... I don't want that...!

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't want to either... *sniff*... 
*hic*...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
There, there... You two really care about 
each other a lot.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...You know, Ryan-chan and I are together 
pretty often.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But we still hang out and play with our 
other classmates or friends who live far 
away, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Because everyone's an important 
friend to us!

text_block_list.name: Girl in Red Hat
text_block_list.text: Everyone's... important...?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's right! No matter how far apart you 
are, as long as you keep each other in 
your hearts, you'll always be precious 
friends!

text_block_list.name: Girl in Red Hat
text_block_list.text:
I get it... *sniff*... I'm sorry for 
getting mad. I want us to stay friends 
forever and ever...

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text: I-I want to be friends forever too...!

text_block_list.name: Girl in Red Hat
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah!
choice_data_list: This way, being apart won't feel lonely.

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text: Big sisters, thank you...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome! And they lived happily 
ever after!

And after parting ways with the girls, on 
our way back to the academy—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Ryan-chan. What would you do if 
I moved somewhere far away?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Eh, well I'd definitely miss you, but... 
even if we're apart, we'll still be us.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, scratch that! Forget I said 
anything! Ha ha, this is so 
embarrassing~~!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~! I want to hear more! What was that 
about being apart~?

text_block_list.name: Girl in Red Hat
text_block_list.text:
But... we won't be able to just meet up 
whenever we want to play...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You can talk on the phone, and hang out on 
days off! That way you won't feel lonely 
even if you don't see each other every 
day!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Because you only see each other once in a 
while, the joy when you finally do meet 
will be doubled!

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text: I see, then maybe it won't be lonely!

text_block_list.name: Girl in Red Hat
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'll call a lot!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, let's shake hands. Not a 
goodbye handshake, but a 'see you again' 
handshake!
